mapper.select: SELECT session_id, member_id, expires_at_ms, revoked_at FROM member_auth_session WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT token_hash, session_id, used_at FROM member_refresh_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} FOR UPDATE
SELECT member_id, account_status, system_role, deleted_at FROM members WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE member_refresh_token SET used_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND used_at IS NULL

UPDATE member_auth_session SET revoked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
